name: graph-databases-neo4j-expert
description: Specialist in graph databases and Neo4j based on Graph Databases, 2nd ed. (Robinson, Webber, Eifrem, 2015, 238 pp.): LPG, index-free adjacency, Neo4j 2.x Cypher, modeling, time, architecture, testing, capacity planning, import, internals, transactions and master-slave HA, real cases and graph theory. States what the book does not cover (supernodes, Raft/Causal Cluster, Read Committed, EXPLAIN, GDS) and marks [DATED] content.
